title: Return-History Share — FlexLine Returned-Payment Fee
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the returned-payment fee is scaled by a return-history share. The return-history share follows the payments returned on the line, the return being charged included: when it is the only return in the last 24 months the share is 0.85; when it is the only return in the last 12 months but another return falls in the last 24 months the share is 0.95; when two or more payments were returned in the last 12 months the share is 1.00. Any other pattern gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the minimum payment due and rounded to the cent. The last 12 months take the returned-payment entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the booking date; the last 24 months, after the same day of the month 24 months before.

| Returns in the last 12 months (the charged one included) | Returns in the last 24 months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0.85 |
| 1 | 2 or more | 0.95 |
| 2 or more | 2 or more | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical case:* the charged return and one earlier return 18 months before the booking date give 0.95; a 15.00 USD figured fee becomes 14.25 USD before the cap and rounding.
